# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 3 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalent)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QH (Cave 1), Col. 3 | **Condition:** Fragmentary

---

**3:1** [...] I thank You, O Lord, for You have caused Your light to shine upon my face because of Your covenant [...]

**3:2** [...] and at daybreak I search for You, and as surely as the sun rises You reveal Yourself to me [...]

**3:3** [...] You have opened my ears to the corrective words of those who rebuke with justice [...]

**3:4** [...] and those who rightly interpret knowledge [...] along with faithful servants [...]

**3:5** [...] You have accomplished this for Your own glory [...] to display Your power [...]

**3:6** [...] and how can any mortal being comprehend all these things [...]

**3:7** [...] and how can anyone grasp [...] Your great design [...]

**3:8** [...] and the dwelling place of [...] the holy ones [...]

**3:9** [...] and the spring of understanding [...] the source of strength [...]

**3:10** [...] and the splendor of [...] kept hidden from mortal eyes [...]

**3:11** [...] I seek You and as surely as the dawn You meet me [...]

**3:12** [...] and those who lead Your people astray have turned on me [...]

**3:13** [...] for they follow their own desires [...] and have never truly sought You [...]

**3:14** [...] in what You commanded [...] they chose what disgusts You [...]

**3:15** [...] and they cast aside what You treasure [...] because of their stubborn hearts [...]

**3:16** [...] they have banded together against me [...] the very people in my own circle [...]

**3:17** [...] and those who shared my table have stabbed me in the back [...]

**3:18** [...] and everyone who joined my community has spoken against me with treachery [...]

**3:19** [...] and my closest confidants [...] have defected to the peddlers of lies [...]

**3:20** [...] with lying tongues [...] and poisonous words they have spoken [...]

**3:21** [...] misinterpreters and false visionaries have plotted against me [...]

**3:22** [...] and they have swapped out Your Teaching from my heart for crowd-pleasing words to Your people [...]

**3:23** [...] and they keep the refreshing waters of knowledge away from those who thirst [...]

**3:24** [...] and instead they pour vinegar for the thirsty to drink [...]

**3:25** [...] so that the people stare at their own delusion and go wild at their feasts [...]

**3:26** [...] and fall into their traps [...]

**3:27** [...] but You, O God, reject every one of Belial's plots [...]

**3:28** [...] and it is Your plan that will prevail [...]

**3:29** [...] and the intention of Your heart that stands firm forever [...]

**3:30** [...] and those phonies hatch plots inspired by Belial [...]

**3:31** [...] they come to You with divided loyalties [...] and have no foundation in Your truth [...]

**3:32** [...] a poisonous root bearing bitter fruit grows in their plans [...]

**3:33** [...] and because of their stubborn hearts they stagger blindly [...]

**3:34** [...] and they look for You among worthless idols [...]

**3:35** [...] and they have placed the very thing that trips them up right before their own eyes [...]

**3:36** [...] and they come seeking You [...] through lying prophets who have themselves been led astray [...]

**3:37** [...] and they speak to Your people in a foreign tongue [...] in alien speech [...]

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 3 is a riveting hymn of betrayal and persecution. The speaker — likely the Teacher of Righteousness — has been abandoned by his own community. The "lifted the heel" image (3:17, cf. Psalm 41:9) is rendered dynamically as "stabbed me in the back" to convey the visceral sense of betrayal. The vinegar-for-knowledge passage (3:23-24) is striking in its parallel to the passion accounts.*
